Subject: Scheduling: Multi-region demo with Acme Corp — finding overlap windows

Hi Sara / Acme team —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. We’d like to schedule a ~60-minute demo to cover: integration patterns (API & dedicated/private options), a short walkthrough of performance/cost controls, and a 15-minute security/Q&A with our security lead. We want procurement on for any commercial/contract questions.

Attendees from our side: Marissa (AE), Aditya (AE), Dylan (SE), Neha (Security), Laura (Procurement). Please let us know who from your side will attend.

Because the team spans US / EU / APAC, below are three fair options (we can rotate later if you’d like recurring sessions):

Option 1 — US-morning friendly:
- 09:00–10:00 PDT / 12:00–13:00 EDT / 17:00–18:00 CET / 01:00–02:00 JST

Option 2 — EU-afternoon friendly (recommended if EU eng lead wants live Q&A):
- 16:00–17:00 CET / 07:00–08:00 PDT / 10:00–11:00 EDT / 00:00–01:00 JST

Option 3 — APAC-friendly (earlier for US):
- 13:00–14:00 JST / 04:00–05:00 CET / 20:00–21:00 PDT / 23:00–00:00 EDT

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf, slide-deck-v1.pptx. I’ve also linked a short SOC2 summary (SOC2-summary.pdf) for your security team.

Can you confirm preferred option and which attendees will join? If none of these windows work, share 2–3 times that do and we’ll flex.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(650) 555-0123

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — this looks great. Attendees from Acme: myself (Product), Tom Müller (EU engineering lead), Kenji Sato (APAC engineer), + procurement and security contacts in cc.

Preliminary constraints:
- Kenji is in Tokyo: anything before 22:00 CET (i.e., late EU evening) is tough for him on weekdays.
- Procurement prefers business hours CET/EST for contract chat but can join the tail end.
- Security wants to review SOC2-summary ahead of time; can attend a short Q&A if within working hours CET.

Our preference is Option 2 (EU-afternoon friendly) but we’d be open to rotating times for future sessions. If Option 2 is workable for your SE, please send a calendar invite and loop security/procurement for the final 15 minutes.

Also: can you add a short mutual action plan (2–3 bullets) in the invite so procurement knows deliverables?

—Sara
